notes.title: Major Patch / Bug Fix Update is Live!
notes.content:
It's been a long time coming, but we've just released a major patch that adds a few requested features, optimizations and improvements, and bug fixes! Thanks so much for your support and patience! You'll find the full list of additions in this update below.

NOTE: This update will unfortunately wipe any save progress in the Gauntlet. Apologies in advance!

[b]PATCH NOTES:[/b]
[list]
    [*]Added an in-level Pause/Quit menu [ESC key]
    [*]Fixed bug preventing Ninja Reflex Steam achievement
    [*]Fixed bug that sometimes prevented final boss unlock
    [*]Fixed memory leak with some particle effects
    [*]Made misc performance improvements
    [*]Added a glow effect to text menus, in-game store objects
    [*]Fixed a few bugs in the final boss
    [*]Misc other minor tweaks,fixes, and adjustments  
[/list]

Thanks again to the player community for letting us know what you think! If you find any additional bugs or issues, please feel free to ping us in the forum!

If you've enjoyed the game and want to help support our work, we'd love it if you'd take a sec to leave a quick Steam review! Thanks!

Also: stay tuned! We're hard at work on our next game, NUCLEAR GOLF, which is headed to PS4, PSVita, Steam and beyond in 2017!

notes.title: Go To Bed: Survive The Night Now Spooking PC
notes.content:
Go To Bed: Survive The Night [official site] is the gamification of all those childhood nights you spent cowering under the covers completely convinced the monsters under your bed were real. They’re not real. They’re not real. They’re…ah, sorry, old habits die hard. It looks simple, but there’s a lot more to it than first meets the eye.

… [visit site to read more]
